intro: Alantra recliner is where every detail is designed for relaxation. With smooth reclining, 360° swivel, and plush cushioning, it’s your go-to spot to sink into pure comfort and unwind after a long day.

features.title: Upholstery that loves you back
features.text: With genuine leather at key touchpoints and durable synthetic leather elsewhere, Alantra offers a premium feel, breathability, and lasting elegance without the upkeep.

features.title: Moves with you, adapts to you
features.text: Adjust to any angle up to 140° with a noiseless reclining mechanism, plus 360° swivel and a gentle rocking feature for ultimate relaxation.

features.title: Support that feels like a warm embrace
features.text: High-density foam and Recron-filled armrests provide deep cushioning, excellent lumbar support, and a soothing, sink-in feel.

features.title: Solid roots timeless strength
features.text: The recliner's frame is made from solid wood with a moisture content of 12%, ensuring robustness and structural integrity. This sturdy frame, combined with a powder-coated metal reclining mechanism, guarantees long-term reliability and strength.

features.title: Luxury in every perfect detail
features.text: The Alantra recliner showcases precise stitching lines and superior craftsmanship, delivering a polished and inviting appearance. Its design offers contemporary aesthetics, aligning with modern living spaces while providing top-notch comfort and usability.

features.title: Sweeps clean stays pristine
features.text: No more juggling snacks or searching for a place to rest your cup. The smart foldable center table with cup holders keeps essentials within arm’s reach, so you can truly unwind.

name: Alantra 3-Seater Leatherette Recliner
